description: This Java interface defines a generic Message class with methods for accessing message headers, payloads, metadata, and related information within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for message creation, payload retrieval, metadata access, and identification of message components, serving as a core part of the messaging model in the project.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for constructing immutable Message instances with specified headers.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers of the message, including client and user-defined headers.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the optional payload of the message, as provided by the sender.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns the optional raw payload (ByteBuffer) of the message as provided by the sender.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns additional data included via signal enrichment.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns the response consumer associated with the message; deprecated.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Indicates whether the message is sent FROM or TO a Thing or Feature.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Deprecated method; returns the ID of the Thing as a String.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed ID of the Thing involved in the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject string of the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the optional feature ID associated with the message.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the optional content type of the payload.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the optional timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the optional timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the optional HTTP status code.
